samples.transcript: Mũciĩ mũnene wa Kenya nĩ ũrĩkũ?
samples.questionEnglish: What is the capital city of Kenya?
samples.answer: The capital city of Kenya is Nairobi.

samples.transcript: Gweta Mũkenya ũrĩa wahotanire ngerenwa ya Nobel Peace Prize ũrĩa wambĩrĩirie Green Belt Movement.
samples.questionEnglish: Name the Kenyan Nobel Peace Prize laureate who founded the Green Belt Movement.
samples.answer: Wangari Maathai is the Kenyan who won the Nobel Peace Prize and started the Green Belt Movement.

samples.transcript: Gweta ndemu ĩrĩa nene ĩheyanaga hinya wa thitima ya maaĩ kuuma Rũũĩ rwa Tana.
samples.questionEnglish: Name the major dam that supplies hydroelectric power from the Tana River.
samples.answer: The large dam on the Tana River that provides hydroelectric power is called the Masinga Dam.
